summary: We have created a storybook for children by describing the missions of robots and space probes that have carried out important tasks in space. The book introduces five different spacecraft, and all the stories are written in language that can capture children's interest. We worked to make this book engaging and inspiring, so that it would spark children's curiosity about space and encourage them to explore the wonders of the universe.
details: It introduces spacecraft in space to children through engaging language and colorful illustrations, aiming to increase their interest in space. With the appeal of a typical children's storybook, it captures their attention and draws them into an exciting and engaging story. The aim of the project is to increase children's interest in space and spacecraft. In our story, we used language and illustrations that would capture children's attention as much as possible. In this way, we also left some parts of the story open to children's imagination and creativity.
